programme.desc: Da en video af Henry og Rays transformation til Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand slipper ud, må Henry gå til ekstremer for at holde sin hemmelighed hemmelig.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Det Omvendte Univers
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte transporteres under en storm til et parallelt univers, hvor Ray og Schwoz er onde og vil Piper til livs. Onde Ray og Onde Schwoz skal standses, og Henry og Charlotte skal tilbage til deres eget univers.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare og Torden
programme.desc: Under infiltration af et hemmeligt forbrydermøde, opdager Phoebe Thunderman, som hjælper Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen, at hendes bror Max er deltager i mødet!

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare og Torden, Anden Del
programme.desc: Under infiltration af et hemmeligt forbrydermøde, opdager Phoebe Thunderman, som hjælper Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen, at hendes bror Max er deltager i mødet!

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tvillinge-Henryer
programme.desc: Henry får en Schwoz-skabt androide til at deltage i familiemiddagen, så Henry selv kan tage til årets MMA-kamp med Charlotte og Ray.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Gravalvorligt
programme.desc: Ray begynder at opføre sig mærkeligt, og da Henry og Charlotte undersøger, hvad der er galt, får de sig en overraskelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Voldkopper
programme.desc: Piper får en mystisk sygdom, så Kaptajn Mand må rejse tilbage til 1700-tallet, for at finde den eneste kur.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Little Secret
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery. The evidence found solves a brutal crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purebread Murder
programme.desc: In 2000, Christina Sanoubane was murdered in her Cedar Rapids apartment after moving away from her abusive boyfriend. There are clues at the scene: bloody footprints and DNA from the victim's rape kit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: In 2006, Darlene VanderGiesen received threatening emails and then disappeared. Tracking the source of the emails led police to the home of Daphne Wright, where they believe a murder was committed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hell's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Kristine Fitzhugh failed to show up for her music class, her husband found her dead at the bottom of the stairs of their Palo Alto home. Further investigation reveals evidence of murder in the kitchen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left her church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. After clearing her husband, police turned their attention to Fred Andros, with whom Susan had an affair.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Squire's Riches
programme.desc: Responding to a 2008 garage fire, Illinois emergency response discovered a man crushed beneath a truck.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bullet With My Name On It
programme.desc: In his first year on the force, rookie patrol officer Joe Kenda quickly learns the ropes. But when he tries to singlehandedly stop a brawling mob, he finds himself facing down gunfire.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Written in Blood
programme.desc: A community is shocked when Antoine McKenzie is brazenly shot outside an auto parts store in broad daylight. The only lead left for Lt. Joe Kenda is a final message written in the victim’s own blood.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Shoelace Killer
programme.desc: A party on the outskirts of the city turns into a nightmare for some teenagers when they discover a woman’s corpse.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Razor’s Edge
programme.desc: When police find 24-year-old Patrick Ray with a gunshot to the temple, the scene has all the telltale signs of suicide. But Lt. Joe Kenda's instinct says otherwise.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Uninvited Guest
programme.desc: A soldier is stabbed to death at a drive-thru. Kenda’s only clue is that this is somehow tied to a breakdancing competition.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Redder Cirkuset / Vov-keliky
programme.desc: Paw Patrol skal finde elefantungen Ellie, der er blevet væk fra cirkustoget. Da Ellies mor også indleder en eftersøgning er der to elefanter på fri fod. // Kylletta er blevet væk. Ryder og Paw patrol må finde hende, så hun kan vende hjem igen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovser på Jagt efter Påskeæg
programme.desc: Vovserne hjælper borgmesteren med at dekorere æg til den årlige æggejagt. Jagten på et helt specielt æg, fører Ryder og Paw Patrol på et spændende eventyr.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovser på is / Vovserne og Snemonsteret
programme.desc: Ryder og Paw Patrol må komme Alex til undsætning under en snowboardudflugt på bjerget. // Da vovserne finder mystiske spor i sneen, tror de, det er et snemonster, der skræmmer skigæsterne væk. Heldigvis får de sig en sjov overraskelse.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserenes Store Ræs / Vovserne og Kagekonkurrencen
programme.desc: Der er væddeløb i byen, men vovserne får deres sag for da en uventet deltager - i form af Alex på sin trehjulede cykel - dukker op. // Hr. Porter deltager i en kagekonkurrence, men da der opstår problemer, er det Paw Patrols opgave at hjælpe til.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovse Boogie / Vovser i Tågen
programme.desc: Paw Patrol skal arbejde hurtigt for at flytte en togvogn inden næste tog ankommer til stationen. Da Rubble slår sin pote, må Chase lære at betjene gravkoen. // Paw Patrol skal skynde sig at få lyset tilbage i fyrtårnet, hvor pæren er gået ud.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vandhunde / Vovser til Efterårsfest
programme.desc: Kaptajn Pighvars båd er strandet på en klippe, så Ryder og Paw Patrol må træde til og hjælpe ham. // Farmer Yumis afgrøder og efterårsfesten bliver truet af en tidlig snestorm, så Paw Patrol må kæmpe mod tiden for at nå at høste.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Redder Lejrturen / Vovserne får Paddeproblemer
programme.desc: Skye og Rocky er på deres første lejrtur, men da Kylletta bliver fanget i en kløft, må de have hjælp fra Paw Patrol. // Der dukker skildpaddeunger op over hele byen, og Paw Patrol må hjælpe dem med at komme i sikkerhed.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne og Bønnestagen / Vovserne redder Pighvar
programme.desc: Rubble tager en lur under et træ og vågner op til et stort problem: Kæmpen Alex. // Kaptajn Pighvar vil tage et billede af en sjælden fugl, men da hans fætter fra Frankrig vil hjælpe, må Paw Patrol komme dem til undsætning.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vovserne Redder Kaninerne / Vovsetastisk
programme.desc: Paw Patrol hjælper farmer Yumi med at fange og flytte de kaniner, som æder hendes gulerødder. // Katie skal deltage i en hvalpekonkurrence, men da Paw Patrol kaldes på opgave, får hun pludselig en uventet frivillig deltager i stedet.

programme.title: iCarly: En sødere Sam
programme.desc: Da Sam indrømmer, at hun kan lide en dreng i skolen, lærer Carly hende, hvordan hun besnærer ham ved at opføre sig mere piget. Spencer er overbevist om, at en pige kan lide ham pga. hans smoking, så han går med den hele tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg dater en forbryder Del 1
programme.desc: Da Carly dater er en hård negl, prøver hun at holde forholdet skjult for Spencer. Og Sam betaler Freddie for at bygge en hjemmeside med alle hendes klamme video-favoritter.

programme.title: iCarly: Gensyn med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle veninde Missy flytter tilbage til Seattle, tror Sam, at Missy prøver at udskifte hende som Carlys bedste veninde.

programme.title: iCarly: Mesterskabet
programme.desc: Da Sam og Freddie vinder konkurrencen for bedste skoleskab begge to, bliver de tvunget til at dele skab. Carly beder Spencer give hende timer i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly Awards
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie uddeler iCarly Awards til det bedste brugerindslag live i webshowet. Spencer hyrer europæiske badetøjsmodeler til at hjælpe med at lave priserne.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillinger
programme.desc: Freddie prøver at bevise, at Melanie, Sams tvillingesøster, er Sam i forklædning. Da Carly underviser Spencers nemesis, Chuck, prøver Spencer at overbevise hende om, at Chuck er ond.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg dater en forbryder Del 2
programme.desc: Da Carly opdager, at hendes "seje" kæreste Griffin samler på små nuttede tøjdyr, må hun beslutte, om hun kan klare at date en fyr med en tøjdyrssamling. Spencer hjælper Sam slippe af med sit mareridt.

programme.title: iCarly: Dingo-tyveri
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer tager hen i Dingo-studiet for at sige, hvad de mener om det.

programme.title: iCarly: Vennekys
programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til at afsløre over for Carly, at hun og Freddie kyssede i smug, konfronterer Carly dem om, hvorfor de ikke fortalte hende det. Og Spencer underviser fængselsfanger i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi laver mad
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie besejrer en berømt tv-kok i en madlavningskonkurrence, vil kokken ikke lave mad mere og nægter at komme ud af sit soveværelse. Spencer prøver at opfylde sin fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: En rektor med karakter
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin fyret, overtager miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og indfører strenge regler. Og Spencer hyrer en gammel rodeostjerne til at lære ham at ride på en mekanisk tyr.
